fullDescription: A warm, searchable help-center / FAQ landing page: teal-on-paper palette, sticky blurred nav, gradient hero with a big search field, category filter pills, icon-headed accordion FAQ groups, and a teal gradient support CTA.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, modern help-center / searchable-FAQ landing page on an off-white paper canvas with a teal brand system. A sticky blurred nav sits above a soft gradient hero with a centered pill eyebrow, a two-line bold question headline, and a large rounded search field with a Cmd+K hint and 'Popular:' quick links. Below, a centered row of pill category filters (the active pill solid teal) leads into icon-headed FAQ groups built from clean white <details> accordion cards (first item open by default, chevron rotates, answer fades in). It closes with a rounded teal gradient 'still need help' CTA card and a minimal split footer.

## Estilo Visual
Design a friendly, airy help-center landing page. Canvas background paper off-white #f8fafc; text in a slate 'ink' ramp (#0f172a / #1e293b / #475569 / #64748b / #94a3b8). Single brand accent is teal: #0f766e (teal-700) for primary buttons, links and icons, #115e59 (teal-800) for the deep CTA card, plus light tints #f0fdfa, #ccfbf1, #99f6e4. Use the Inter font family (weights 400/500/600/700/800). Lean on lots of whitespace, fully-rounded controls, soft long shadows tinted with rgba teal (e.g. shadow-teal-900/20), and faint blurred radial gradient blobs in teal-100/200 for atmospheric depth. Keep the tone warm and human, never corporate.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0, z-50) with a translucent paper background (bg-paper/85) and backdrop-blur-xl, a hairline bottom border (border-ink-900/[0.06]), height 64px. Left: brand lockup = a rounded-lg teal-700 icon tile (8x8, sparkle/asterisk glyph in white) plus extrabold wordmark 'Mosaic' with a teal-700 period. Center (md+ only): horizontal nav links Library / Canvas / Pricing / Help at 14px medium ink-600, the current link ('Help') semibold teal-700. Right: a 'Sign in' text link and a solid teal-700 'Start free' button (rounded-lg, px-4 py-2, white, soft teal shadow).

### Hero with search
A centered hero (max-w-3xl) on a top-to-bottom gradient from teal-50/70 to paper, with two large blurred teal radial blobs absolutely positioned behind it. Stack: a pill eyebrow ('Help Center', rounded-full, teal-200 border, white/70 bg, 12.5px semibold teal-700, leading globe icon); a 34/44px extrabold tracking-tight ink-900 headline broken over two lines ('How can we help you / design today?'); a 15px ink-500 supporting line. Then a prominent search field: rounded-2xl white box, ink-900/10 border, lg teal-tinted shadow, left search icon, full-width transparent input with placeholder, and a right ⌘K kbd chip (paper bg, rounded-md). On focus the field gets a teal-500 border + 4px teal ring. Below it a 13px 'Popular:' line with three underline-on-hover quick links.

### Category filter pills
A full-width band (border-y hairline) holding a centered, wrap-friendly flex row of rounded-full category pills (gap-2.5). The first pill ('All topics') is the active state: solid teal-700, white text, soft shadow. The rest are inactive: white bg, ink-900/10 border, ink-600 medium text, each with a small teal-600 leading icon, hovering to a teal-300 border + teal-700 text. Labels: All topics, Getting started, Prompt library, Billing & credits, Skill & agents, Export.

### Accordion FAQ groups
Several FAQ groups (max-w-5xl, generous vertical rhythm). Each group has a header row: an 11x11 rounded-xl teal-700 icon tile (white icon) beside an 18px bold ink-900 group title and a 13px ink-500 one-line description. Under it, a vertical stack (grid gap-3) of accordion cards built as native <details> elements: rounded-xl, white bg, ink-900/10 border, padded summary row (15px semibold ink-800 question on the left, a 16px teal-700 chevron on the right). The chevron rotates 180deg when open; the open card gets a teal-200 border and a soft teal drop shadow; the answer (14px ink-500 relaxed leading) fades/slides in. Render the first card of the first group open by default. Groups: 'Getting started', 'Prompt library', 'Billing & credits'.

### Still-need-help CTA
A full-bleed-within-container CTA card: rounded-3xl, solid teal-800 background, centered text, xl teal shadow, with two blurred teal radial blobs (teal-600/40 and teal-900/40) bleeding off the corners. Inside: a 24/28px extrabold white headline ('Still stuck? We're real people.'), a 15px teal-100 subline, and a button row (stacks on mobile): a primary white button with teal-800 text ('Message support', chat icon) and a secondary ghost button with a white/25 border and white text ('Join the community', Discord-style icon).

### Footer
A minimal footer on paper bg with a hairline top border: a single row (max-w-6xl) that stacks on mobile, left = a 6x6 rounded-md teal-700 icon tile + 'Mosaic Help Center' in semibold ink-600, right = a 13px ink-400 copyright line ('© 2026 Mosaic. Design from a prompt.').

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Large rounded-2xl search field with left search icon, transparent input, a right ⌘K keyboard-shortcut chip, and a teal focus ring (border-teal-500 + ring-4 ring-teal-500/15).

### Componente
Centered, wrap-friendly category filter pill row where the active pill is solid teal-700 and the rest are bordered white with teal-600 leading icons.

### Componente
Native <details>/<summary> accordion cards: chevron rotates 180deg on open, open card gains a teal-200 border + soft teal shadow, answer fades/slides in via CSS keyframes (no JS).

### Componente
Icon-tile group headers: 11x11 rounded-xl teal-700 tiles pairing a white glyph with a title + sub-description.

### Componente
Teal-800 gradient CTA card with off-canvas blurred radial blobs and a primary/ghost button pair.

## Notas Especiais
Built with Tailwind (CDN) and a custom palette: paper #f8fafc; teal 50 #f0fdfa, 100 #ccfbf1, 200 #99f6e4, 500 #14b8a6, 600 #0d9488, 700 #0f766e, 800 #115e59, 900 #134e4a; ink 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a. Font: Inter (400/500/600/700/800). Icons are inline Phosphor SVGs using currentColor. Accordions are pure HTML <details> (no JS) with CSS transitions; depth comes from soft teal-tinted shadows and blurred radial blobs, not heavy borders. Responsive: nav links and ⌘K chip hide on small screens, headline break only shows sm+, CTA buttons stack on mobile. Strictly avoid em-dashes in copy and keep the voice warm and reassuring.
